YOU ARE JACOB SMITH

Wildlife Investigator, Wildlife Response Division.

You have been assigned a seven-case investigation involving abnormal native wildlife and mutated animal cells. Your job is to document each infected animal, collect a tissue sample, infiltrate the infected cell through MARS, identify the disease from three cellular evidences, and repair the affected cellular process.
